body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Motorola presented ''MOTORAZR V3x'' handset capable of 2-way video calling during CES 2007.
It features 60MB internal memory and a microSD memory expansion slot.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
